compiled_state.description:
## Symptom

`make verify` on a developer box reported **9 failed, 19436 passed** — eight of them
`rebar.llm.errors.GateCongestedError: gate admission refused: all 4 concurrent gate slots busy`
(plus `test_plan_review_cli_retry::test_cli_retry_is_compatible_with_no_sign`, `assert 11 == 2`,
the same cause surfacing as a retry count).

Affected: `test_opcert_producer_seam_8d8e`, `test_plan_review_cli_retry`, `test_plan_review_retry`,
`test_gate_peak_rss_9ea3`, `test_eval_solver`, `test_repo_isolation_guard`.

## Root cause (confirmed, not inferred)

`llm/gate_admission._slot_dir()` is `store_root() / "locks"` — the **per-host snapshot store**,
deliberately, so the counter follows `REBAR_GATE_TMPDIR`. The cap is 4. Those tests exercise the
real `gate_admission` context manager, so they compete for the same four slots as **live** gate
runs.

At the time of the failing run, `ps` showed a concurrent real gate from an unrelated session:

```
25001  05:24  /Users/joeoakhart/comment-remediation-3e32/.venv/bin/rebar review-plan verminous-zealous-krill
24863  05:33  rtk proxy .venv/bin/rebar review-plan verminous-zealous-krill
```

Two live gates plus `-n 6` test workers exceeded the cap, so the refusals were CORRECT behaviour
of the cap and incorrect behaviour of the tests.

A/B on the same host confirms it is not a source regression: the identical selection passed on
`origin/main` sources and passed again on the change under test once the slots freed
(20 passed, then 20 passed; then the remaining 51 passed).

## Why this matters

`make verify` is the stated local CI contract ("the only local command that lets you say I verified
this and be right"). A verdict that flips on whether a colleague — or another agent session on the
same box, which is the normal case here — happens to be running a gate is not that. It also trains
the exact habit AGENTS.md forbids: seeing a red `make verify`, assuming flake, and re-running.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] Gate-admission tests do not contend with live gate runs: the suite gets its own slot
      namespace (e.g. an autouse fixture pointing `REBAR_GATE_TMPDIR` — or the slot dir seam —
      at `tmp_path`). Checked by starting a real long-running gate on the host, then
      `pytest tests/unit/test_gate_peak_rss_9ea3.py tests/unit/test_plan_review_retry.py tests/unit/test_opcert_producer_seam_8d8e.py tests/unit/test_plan_review_cli_retry.py tests/unit/test_eval_solver.py tests/unit/test_repo_isolation_guard.py -q`
      and seeing it green.
- [ ] The isolation is enforced, not conventional: a test that reaches the shared per-host slot
      dir fails. Checked by a guard test asserting the resolved slot dir is under the test tmp
      root during the suite.
- [ ] `GateCongestedError` is not reachable from the default suite for environmental reasons.
      Checked by `grep -c "GateCongestedError: gate admission refused" <make verify log>` being 0
      on a host with a live gate running.

## Testing

1. Reproduce deterministically: hold N slots from a helper process, then run the six modules —
   they must go red before the fix and green after.
2. No behaviour change to the cap itself; only the tests' slot namespace moves.
compiled_state.title: gate-admission unit tests take REAL production slots, so `make verify` reddens when any other session runs a live gate on the same host
